integrity: The proof uses established Legendre identities and derives the exact all-degree BV-to-L2 norm and equality classification. Computational checks are finite corroboration, not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted real one-dimensional Legendre projectors only; no weighted, multidimensional or pointwise claims. The 1981 Bojanic–Vuilleumier full text was inaccessible, so historical completeness cannot be guaranteed.
title: Sharp all-degree Legendre projection error on bounded-variation data
